campaign: LEXIGEN v5 Causal Transfer Generalization Experiment

implementation_policy.generic_same_operator_tuple: identical generic operator tuples across arms resolve through the same cached implementation function and are semantically equivalent by construction
implementation_policy.learned_template_separation: learned-template candidates use distinct frozen recipe implementations keyed by transfer-memory template name; v5_no_transfer contains no learned template or causal ID
implementation_policy.bit_frontier_restriction: sparse k-nearest-neighbour frontier connected components plus structural certificate; certificate failure falls back to exact HDBSCAN
implementation_policy.certified_active_core: density-selected core subset clustered and lifted; structural certificate failure falls back to exact HDBSCAN
implementation_policy.reduced_representation_refinement: deterministic reduced subset clustered and lifted; structural certificate failure falls back to exact HDBSCAN
implementation_policy.generic_decomposition: base-operator compositions use deterministic active-core/reduced/frontier primitives without learned-template certificate semantics
implementation_policy.exact_path: otherwise use frozen-reference HDBSCAN semantics with only representation/dtype transformations requested by operators
